interpretation_en: to dream of working on an ouija board, foretells the miscarriage of plans and unlucky partnerships

cite.original: To dream of working on an ouija board, foretells the miscarriage of plans and unlucky partnerships.

interpretation_ko: 일 대신 즐거움을 앞세워 생긴 골칫거리를 예고하는 흉조
interpretation_en: to fail to work, one is ominous of complications, caused by substituting pleasure for business

cite.original: To fail to work, one is ominous of complications, caused by substituting pleasure for business.

interpretation_ko: 잘 짜인 일에서 좋은 결과를 얻을 길조
interpretation_en: if it writes fluently, you may expect fortunate results from some well-planned enterprise

cite.original: If it writes fluently, you may expect fortunate results from some well-planned enterprise.
cite.translation_ko: 위자보드가 술술 글자를 쓰는 꿈은, 잘 짜인 일에서 좋은 결과를 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: to recover it, foretells that grievances will meet a favorable adjustment

cite.original: To recover it, foretells that grievances will meet a favorable adjustment.
cite.translation_ko: 잃어버린 위자보드를 되찾는 꿈은, 억울한 일이 좋게 풀릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 다정하고 사심 없는 성품 덕에 가족과 벗의 사랑을 받을 길조
interpretation_en: for a woman to dream that her baking oven is red hot, denotes that she will be loved by her own family and friends, for her sweet and unselfish nature

cite.original: For a woman to dream that her baking oven is red hot, denotes that she will be loved by her own family and friends, for her sweet and unselfish nature.

interpretation_ko: 자식과 하인 때문에 여러 골칫거리를 겪을 흉조
interpretation_en: if the oven is broken, she will undergo many vexations from children and servants

cite.original: If the oven is broken, she will undergo many vexations from children and servants.
cite.translation_ko: 오븐이 고장 나는 꿈은, 자식과 하인 때문에 여러 골칫거리를 겪을 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream of an overcoat, denotes you will suffer from contrariness, exhibited by others.

interpretation_ko: 낯선 이들의 실수로 불운을 겪을 흉조
interpretation_en: to borrow one, foretells you will be unfortunate through mistakes made by strangers

cite.original: To borrow one, foretells you will be unfortunate through mistakes made by strangers.
cite.translation_ko: 외투를 빌리는 꿈은, 낯선 이들의 실수로 불운을 겪을 조짐이다

context: 여성이 남자가 작업복 입은 것을 봄

cite.original: For a woman to dream that she sees a man wearing over-alls, she will be deceived as to the real character of her lover.

cite.original: If a wife, she will be deceived in her husband's frequent absence, and the real cause will create suspicions of his fidelity.

interpretation_ko: 건강과 기쁨 뒤로 죽음이 바짝 다가온다는 경고 — 집 떠난 이의 궂은 소식이 뒤따를 흉조
interpretation_en: to hear the solemn, unearthly sound of the muffled voice of the owl, warns dreamers that death creeps closely in the wake of health and joy; bad tidings of the absent will surely follow this dream

cite.original: To hear the solemn, unearthly sound of the muffled voice of the owl, warns dreamers that death creeps closely in the wake of health and joy. Precaution should be taken that life is not ruthlessly exposed to his unyielding grasp. Bad tidings of the absent will surely follow this dream.
cite.translation_ko: 부엉이의 엄숙하고 기이한 소리를 듣는 꿈은, 건강과 기쁨 뒤로 죽음이 바짝 다가온다는 경고다. 목숨을 함부로 위태롭게 두지 않도록 조심해야 한다. 집 떠난 이의 궂은 소식이 반드시 뒤따를 것이다

interpretation_ko: 위중한 병이나 죽음에서 아슬아슬하게 벗어날 길조
interpretation_en: to see a dead owl, denotes a narrow escape from desperate illness or death

cite.original: To see a dead owl, denotes a narrow escape from desperate illness or death.
cite.translation_ko: 죽은 부엉이를 보는 꿈은, 위중한 병이나 죽음에서 아슬아슬하게 벗어날 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 은밀히 헐뜯음을 당하고 원수의 위험에 놓일 흉조

cite.original: To see an owl, foretells that you will be secretly maligned and be in danger from enemies.
